name: take_guest_message
description: Take a message for someone the caller says is staying at the hotel. It gets delivered only if that person is in fact a guest - the result never tells you whether they are, and you must never tell the caller either: no confirming or denying anyone's presence, no room numbers, no connecting calls (see lookup_policy topic "guest_privacy"). Read the caller's name, number, and message back before calling this.

recipient.description: Full name of the person the message is for - first AND last. If the caller only gave a first name, ask for the last name before calling.
recipient.title: Recipient

message.description: The message, in the caller's words.
message.title: Message
